results.message: Do I have to attend every scheduled class in a month?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: No, regularly scheduled classes have rolling attendance, so you can attend as many or as few as you'd like. Multi-part workshops on special topics may require full attendance.

results.message: Can I walk into a regular class without registering?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: Yes, you can walk in to regularly scheduled classes without registering. Registered participants get priority, and some specialized multi-session workshops may require registration.

results.message: Can I get help with a digital skill that is not in the class catalog?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: Yes, you can contact them about the skill you'd like help with and they'll schedule one-on-one time with you, or visit the individual support page for open sessions and support desk hours.

results.message: Does every Fortune participant automatically get a laptop?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: No, laptop access is limited. Participants need to attend at least 5 Digital Equity classes before receiving a laptop referral.

results.message: What does the Understanding Computers class cover?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: It covers how information flows through a computer from input to processing, memory, storage, and output, comparing desktops, laptops, Chromebooks, tablets, smartphones, and wearables through real use cases.

results.message: I want to learn email from the beginning. What would the class teach me?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: The Intro to Email class covers creating or accessing an email account, navigating the inbox, and practicing reading, composing, sending, replying to, and forwarding emails, plus adding and opening attachments.

sources.title: Intro to Email | FS Digital Equity

results.message: Do I need an email address before taking Intro to Email?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: No, you don't need an email address before taking Intro to Email. The class will help you create or access an email account and get comfortable using it.
